batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: run out (A Mithun, AB de Villiers)

batting.name: JR Hopes
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b A Mithun

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c Z Khan b S Aravind

batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c Y Venugopal Rao b JR Hopes

batting.name: TM Dilshan
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b AB Dinda

batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b M Morkel

batting.name: CA Pujara
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b Y Nagar

batting.name: A Mithun
batting.dismissal: c UT Yadav b M Morkel

balls.text: Nagar walks down the pitch and tries to play on the leg, he misses and gets hit on the pad for a leg bye towards the off, Sehwag said 160-170 would be competitive, he's got 160.
the slower ball outside off, Nagar swings across the line but misses
that's too wide outside off stump
slower ball outside off, Pathan hits it through cover
No it wasn't! Here's another, Pathan frees his arms, swings hard, and clobbers the length ball over long off
a full ball in the blockhole and Pathan once again fails to make contact, was that six a false dawn?

caught! Ojha skies the slower ball high in the air over cover, Zaheer ran back from the infield, Pujara from the boundary also ran towards the ball. There could have been a collision but Pujara pulled out in the end and Zaheer took it
another full ball outside off stump beats Pathan
the slower ball outside off stump, Pathan heaves and fails
full ball outside off stump, Pathan swings and misses, the umpire calls it wide. Harsh call. Pathan edged that towards the keeper. The ball bounced before reaching AB
Pathan aims for the flamboyant drive over cover but gets beaten by a full ball wide outside off
bang! Length ball angling into the left-hander, Pathan lines it up and smashes through the line, hitting it flat and over the long-on boundary
now it's full but wide outside off, Pathan lets it go
that's a wayward delivery down leg side, Pathan swung but had no hope of making contact

caught behind! But the umpire is checking if Mithun over-stepped again. This time he hasn't, but by the skin of his teeth. Hopes aimed for the big swing down the ground and the angle of the ball across the right-hander induced the edge to the keeper
a fullish ball outside off, the batsman makes room and carves the ball in the air and over extra cover
Hopes moves outside leg, Gayle follows him, Hopes clips the ball off his pads towards deep square leg
driven hard along the ground towards long off
Hopes swings the ball towards deep backward square leg
flat and fast from round the wicket, Ojha plays towards point
the reverse-swat from outside leg stump towards short third man, Hopes reaches fifty after being sent up the order
Hopes picks out the gap between deep midwicket and long-on, he waited for the full ball and simply lofted it into the gap with power
that's huge. Not pretty but huge. Ojha stood his ground, waited for the short of a length ball and flat-batted it down the ground, clearing the long-on boundary comfortably
Ojha hits the ball hard from his crease but can't beat midwicket
cut firmly towards the fielder at third man
Hopes aims for the road outside the Kotla, so powerful was his swing, but Zaheer beat him with a good length ball that angled across the right-hander
Hopes aims for midwicket with the pull but toe-ends it towards the bowler
Zaheer slants the ball across Hopes and bowls extremely full outside off, Hopes can't reach it and the umpire calls it wide
guided towards third man for a single
driven through cover for one
that's out of here! Well, only just. Ojha takes on Vettori, clears his front foot and launches the ball high towards long-off where the fielder leaps in vain on the boundary
full toss, but very straight, Ojha makes room and drives to cover
full ball in the blockhole, driven to cover
Ojha plays the ball from his crease towards cover
bowled him! Venu charges Vettori and swings across the line, a rather rash slog. Vettori slows it down and beats the bat with ease, his line his straight and he hits the stumps
full and wide outside off, cut to the fielder at point
short ball outside off, the batsman chases and misses
full toss on the pad, flicked firmly but to midwicket

caught at point! The ball was average, full and wide outside off, and Hopes went after it, slashing with power. He didn't get enough elevation though and Dilshan throws the ball high in the air after taking a sharp chance. The umpire wants to check if Mithun has over-stepped though, and he has. Marginally. That will do though. Hopes stays and has a free-hit coming up.
Hopes tries to hit the ball a bit too hard and mis-times it towards the bowler
short of a length on leg and middle, Venu plays the ball towards midwicket and sets off
just a flick of the wrists, as Shastri would say. Too full on leg and Venu launches it with a firm flick, sending the ball soaring over deep backward square leg
Venu tries to nudge the ball on the leg side but gets hit on the pad
Hopes moves forward and turns the ball through square
full toss on the pads, Venu nudges through the leg side for a single
full ball in the blockhole, pushed down the ground for a single
nudged off the pads gently into the gap at midwicket and they run two before the man on the boundary can get to it. Delhi pass 100
Vettori strays down leg side and will have to bowl that again
Venu steps out and plays the ball off his pads through square
cut off the back foot towards third man
too short, Hopes waits in his crease, winds up and slams the ball flat towards the same region, the ball bounces just before going over the deep midwicket boundary
Hopes has blitzed this. Down on one knee and a powerful swing, the ball screams across the turf to the deep midwicket boundary
Venu sends the square leg umpire scurrying with a powerful slog sweep to deep square leg
Venu takes a step out, the bowler sees him coming and shortens the length, played back to the bowler
played towards deep square leg
defended on the leg side

he's teed off! Venugopal stood his ground and swung a length ball in the air towards wide long-on. Has it cleared the boundary? It's been called six but it bounced a couple of feet inside the boundary. The decision is changed to four.
driven towards long-off
defended from the crease behind point for a single
played back to the bowler from the crease
a low full toss but Venu just gets under it, lofting it cleanly over the bowler's head for four
the bowler's over-stepped while bowling a length ball outside off, the batsman tried to cut but was beaten, free hit coming up
swept towards long leg for a single
played towards deep midwicket
played towards midwicket for a risky single, the throw towards AB wasn't good and he missed the back flick on to the stumps
driven off the front foot towards cover point
defended on the back foot on the off side
the left-arm spinner angles the ball into the right-hander, nudged off the pads behind square
driven powerfully towards point where the fielder takes the pace off the ball
left alone outside off stump

bowled him! Mithun pitched it on a good length and straight from over the wicket and got the ball to straighten slightly, Wade aimed for the heave over midwicket and missed, the ball hit middle and off
length ball outside off, Hopes plays the cut and the fielder at backward point fails to make a clean stop
tight line and length, cramping the left-hander for room, Wade plays from his crease towards the off
length ball around off stump, driven off the front foot towards deep cover
flat ball outside off, played towards short third man
bowled flat and straight, Hopes flicks the ball firmly through midwicket and has placed it in the gap on the boundary
Wade makes room and slogs the ball along the ground to long-off
played with power towards the fielder at deep midwicket, along the ground
driven hard towards the bowler, Vettori stretches out his right hand and fields
driven off the front foot towards long off
played back to the bowler
played towards midwicket where a fumble from the fielder allows the second
Hopes makes room and times the cut superbly past Zaheer at short third man, the chase is poor
Hopes attempts the drive but edges the full ball fine past the keeper for four runs
played behind square for a single
played towards midwicket for a quick single
defended back towards the bowler
played towards midwicket
that was wide down leg side but Wade felt the need to get bat on ball and play it to short fine leg

Sehwag is run out! Hopes played the ball towards short fine leg and set off, Sehwag responded but the fielder unleashed at accurate throw to de Villiers who whipped off the bails with Sehwag an inch short, he slid his bat in but wasn't quick enough
Sehwag steps out to Vettori and drives the ball towards long-on
edged but short! Sehwag went hard at this one, aiming to hit the ball down the ground, but the outside edge fell well short of Gayle at first slip
Hopes drives the ball fluently towards wide mid-off where Tiwary dives to his left and stops it
forced off the back foot to the fielder on the deep square leg boundary
poor line, much to straight and Hopes glances the ball off his pads towards the long leg boundary
played from the crease towards the off side
Aravind gets the ball to move away sharply off the seam from a good length and beats Hopes outside off
Sehwag lets it go, the length was good and the line just a bit too wide outside off, the ball nearly bounced a second time before reaching de Villiers
pitches on leg and gives the right-hander no room, played from the crease towards midwicket
good length once again outside off, pushed from the crease towards extra cover
good length on off stump, defended on the off side

bowled him! Zaheer pitches on a good length and moves the ball in sharply towards the left-hander, Warner aimed for another big drive but was beaten by movement and played the wrong line, the ball crashed into the stumps
first boundary for Warner, driving a full ball off the front foot between the bowler and mid-on, superb contact
played off the pads from the crease
the ball pitches on a good length and moves away off the seam, Warner pushes and is beaten
there's no width but Sehwag cuts anyway, from his stumps to the fielder at  deep point
pitches outside leg and Sehwag once again works the ball into the gap at midwicket
Warner checks his drive and plays the ball towards mid-on to turn the strike over
played back to the bowler off the front foot
Warner gets cramped for room by the angle into him and nudges the ball off his pads towards midwicket
fuller ball just outside off, driven towards mid-off for a single
too wide outside off again but this time Sehwag misses the slash
superb ball, Zaheer angles the ball across the right-hander, pitches on a good length and straightens it into Sehwag, who tries to drive but is beaten between bat and pad
short outside off stump and Sehwag cuts the ball with power through the gap at point
Warner doesn't know where the ball is after getting an inside edge, Sehwag sees that it's gone close to the stumps on the leg side and sprints the single
Zaheer strays down leg side, de Villiers moves to his right to collect
excellent ball, Sehwag is beaten on the back-foot punch once again by the left-armer's angle from over the wicket
Sehwag tries to drive one that pitches short of a length and slants across him and is beaten once again
flicked powerfully off the pads towards deep square leg, the throw is good at the bowler's end but Warner is too quick between the wickets
edged and four! Sehwag edges one that angles across him from over the wicket and the ball falls short of AB and hits the glove before going past first slip towards the boundary
a touch too straight and Sehwag flicks the ball off his pads through midwicket
shoddy fielding at short third man, Sehwag slashed at a wide one and Zaheer failed to get down quickly enough and merely took pace off the ball when he should have stopped it
Warner punches a full ball towards mid-off
"Catch it Zak," says AB as Sehwag hits the ball in the air but just wide of the bowler, Sehwag mis-timed that and ran a quick single
good length this time and closer to the right-hander, Sehwag pokes from his crease and gets beaten
crashed, Sehwag plants his foot forward and drives the length ball through wide mid-off
a full toss on leg stump creases into Warner's pads, he will be disappointed he did not slam that away
full and straight, in the blockhole, Warner stays in his crease and pushes it towards cover
Bangalore have done it! Mohammad plays a short-arm pull to square leg and sprints the winning single
dropped, Vettori spoons the drive in the air towards mid-off where Pathan dives forward and gets hands to the ball but spills it, Delhi had a lifeline at the last moment but Pathan goofed it up
full ball outside off, Mohammad reaches for it and steers to third man
Mohammad tries to drive but ends up slicing the ball through point to Warner in the deep
an excellent bouncer from Hopes, Mohammed tries to hook but misses
Vettori moves back and gently swats the ball along the ground through midwicket
Vettori swings the game decisively towards Bangalore by making room and slicing the ball in the air and into the gap on the backward point boundary
in the blockhole outside off stump, steered towards third man
full toss and Vettori swats it towards long off where Morkel slides to his left and fields
full and wide outside off, poor line
Mohammad you beauty! He uses the pace of the ball and steers the ball deftly towards third man and beats the diving fielder
shot! Mohammad uses the angle into him to pick the ball off his pads and flick it behind square, the fielder dives on the boundary but fails to make the save
Vettori spoons the ball through cover off the front foot, and takes the single
bat on ball towards cover and Vettori charges through for the single
short of a length outside off, Mohammad cuts hard but makes no contact, Vettori watches helplessly
Mohammad edges the ball into the ground towards the keeper
mindless batting from Mithun. He just needs to stay there with Vettori, but what does he do? Attempts a big shot, that's what. He mis-times it in the air and Yadav takes the catch at deep extra cover
Mithun is the new batsman, he swings and misses
caught behind! Morkel salvages a terrible over by dismissing Tiwary! He bowled a full ball outside off, Tiwary bent low and tried to steer it towards third man, he ended up edging it straight to Ojha
short ball pulled towards deep midwicket

Vettori moves way outside the off stump to play the ball, Morkel bowls it full and wide outside off, just inside the tram line, Vettori gets beaten but the ball is called wide. That is a rubbish call, it was inisde the tram line and Vettori had moved a log way towards the ball
Tiwary tries to hook the short ball and top-edges it over the keeper
he over-steps! Tiwary plays the ball on the off side and wants the risky single, Vettori sends him back, free-hit coming up ...
Tiwary has mauled Morkel over deep midwicket, short of a length ball and Tiwary got under it and heaved the ball powerfully over the boundary, is that the game breaker?
full toss outside off, walks across and gets down low to sweep but can't make contact
Vettori blinds the keeper and even though he misses the heave from outside off he ensures the keeper can't see it as well, he moved outside off to block the keeper's vision and swung across the line
flicked through midwicket for a single
Vettori misses the force through the off side and the keeper fumbles it
ah a pressure release, Vettori makes room  by moving towards leg, Pathan responds with a length ball with width, Vettori launches it over long-off
Vettori swings hard at Pathan but gets beaten
length ball outside off, Tiwary tries to beat the cork out of the ball once again but mis-times it to cover
smashed! Length ball and Tiwary clubs it with raw power straight past the bowler, no stopping that
Vettori moves right across his stumps and flicks a full ball from middle towards long leg, risky shot but he plays it often
good length and straight, driven from the crease to long-off
cut towards third man for a single
Vettori moves inside the line by walking across his stumps and tries to pull to long leg, he misses
nudged off the pads through midwicket, two off the over, three economical ones in a row
Vettori gets a leading edge to a delivery that stops on him a touch from short of a length, it lobs safely on the off side
Vettori tries to run the ball down to third man but gets beaten
good length but on the pads, Tiwary misses the flick but gets a leg bye
Tiwary cuts again but can't get past point again
excellent line and length, no room for the left-hander, Tiwary plays to point
dabbed off the back foot towards backward point, another tight over from Delhi
defended on the front foot towards the bowler
swatted from outside off towards deep midwicket

that's a really long hop but Pujara has picked out the incredible Warner at deep midwicket. Nagar gave Pujara plenty of time to place the ball but all he managed to do was go back and loft it straight to the fielder. Could have hit that anywhere really.
too short but Tiwary only manages to biff it off the back foot towards long-on
nudged off the pads on the leg side
played towards backward point, Pathan makes a strong comeback after getting caned in his first over
driven off the front foot towards cover
defended with soft hands on the off side and good running from the batsmen, focussing on the singles
tight line and length, on off and middle, nudged towards cover for a quick single
good length and straight, that kept low as well. Tiwary stays in his crease and defends towards point
width offered outside off and Pujara cuts in front of point
Hopes angles the ball into the right-hander, Pujara works the ball behind square and settle for the single against Warner
nudged off the hips towards square
a bit of width outside off, Pujara cuts in front of point, Bangalore reach 100, only 61 more to get
nudged off the hips towards midwicket
Hopes tumbles to the ground on his follow through and Tiwary pushes the ball past him for a single
Pujara bottom edges the cut into the ground towards backward point and Tiwary calls him through for a quick single
good length ball angles into the left-hander, Tiwary plays it towards square leg
worked off the pads through midwicket
played from the crease towards backward point
pace and bounce from Morkel outside off, Pujara lets it go
played back to the bowler from the crease
bowled him! Huge wicket. Kohli was batting superbly but this time he pushes tentatively at a good length ball outside off and gets an inside edge back on to his stumps. Delhi are right back in this
flicked to Warner at deep square once again, they don't even think about the second

a direct hit from the deep and AB is gone. Kohli flicked the ball towards deep midwicket and the batsman wanted two because the fielder had to get to the ball from deep square leg. That fielder was Warner, though, and he tore across the ground, swooped on the ball and unleashed a flat throw at the bowler's end that hit direct and caught de Villiers miles short of his crease. And AB's one of the fastest runners in cricket. Stunning outcricket from Warner.
played towards point from the crease
defended off the back foot towards point
de Villiers uses the pace and line of the ball to guide it towards third man, placing it fine enough to beat the fielder
full ball on the pads, flicked along the ground to deep square leg
pushed off the back foot towards point
nudged on the leg side for a single
no relief from Kohli though, he gets to 50 by flicking the ball off the back foot through square leg, finds the gap on the boundary

caught at deep square leg, Gayle's gone! Hopes bangs it in short and Gayle plays an awkward pull that looks a bit like a slap, he skies it in the air and Venu runs in from the boundary to take a catch that will give Delhi relief
full ball outside leg, Gayle makes room by moving his front foot and swings the ball behind square
driven from the crease towards long-on
he plays to third man again, this time along the ground
short and wide outside off stump, Kohli slashes and slashes hard, sending the ball high and far over the third-man boundary
Kohli gets beaten by a fast one outside off
length ball on the pads and Kohli flicks, and how. He times it superbly and places it fine of the fielder on the deep square boundary
a skiddy ball hurries Gayle and he gets hit on the pad outside leg stump, runs a leg bye behind square
Kohli works the ball towards midwicket
defended with soft hands towards cover and they steal a single
Gayle uses the angle into him to open the face and guide the ball towards third man
Kohli works the ball towards midwicket and sets off for the single, Gayle responds and makes it even through there is a direct hit at the batsman's end
Kohli makes room and tries to hit it a bit too hard, he was aiming for over the blower but mis-hit it to him
pushed from the crease towards point
defended back towards the bowler
Gayle jumps forward and out towards the leg side, and flicks a full ball off his pads with power through midwicket, he's not about to be out-batted by Kohli without a fight
played on the leg side for  a single

pulled over long leg for six! Kohli moves towards the off to get inside the line of a short ball and pulls flat and hard, Morkel - the tallest Delhi player - was on the boundary and the ball sped over his head
Gayle nudges the ball - better length and line - off his pads towards midwicket
too short, a bit of width outside off, and Gayle has sat back in his crease and slapped the ball through cover, Bangalore steam to 50
short of a length and straight, Kohli moves back and across and plays the ball towards midwicket
well he's hit that, not into south Delhi, but miles over the long-on boundary. Gayle made room, Morkel tried to follow him, but got hammered
carved over cover! Gayle sits back in his crease and slams the ball flat over the in field, it was too short and the ball pitched just inside the boundary
Gayle's had enough, he backs away towards leg stump and tries to clobber the ball into south Delhi, gets beaten though
strays on to the pads, Kohli turns it towards fine leg
good length outside off, Kohli moves forward and drives to cover, not timed fluently
Gayle defends one from a good length on the back foot
Kohli plays the ball towards point by opening the face
another length ball which keeps a touch low outside off, Kohli plays towards cover
length ball with width outside off, Kohli drives fluently but doesn't find the gap at cover
another one strays down leg side and this time Ojha's dive can't stop the ball, Delhi are looking ragged
left along outside off stump
Dinda will have to bowl that again after straying down leg
he's away now, driving a length ball towards cover and calling Kohli through
Gayle finally gets back on strike and defends a short of a length ball on the leg side, he hasn't got off the mark yet
too full and a touch too straight, Kohli moves forward and across and flicks through midwicket, the timing is simply too good and Pathan is looking helpless already
played off the front foot on the leg side
Kohli uses the width outside off to lean forward and drive the ball on the up wide of mid-off for four
this time he keeps it outside off, far better line, Kohli moves back and across and lets it go
terrible line, on leg stump, Kohli plays the glance to the fine leg boundary, rubbish start from Pathan
the full ball on middle and leg, Kohli helps himself to the loose ball, clipping it off his pads through square leg
punched off the front foot towards cover
terrific timing, the previous one was in front of point, this one is behind, Kohli uses the width and pace to cut the ball to the boundary
width offered outside off stump and Kohli punches fluently off the back foot, threading the ball through the gap at point, the length was too short as well
good length ball outside off stump, Dinda gets the ball to swing away from Kohli, who lets it go
caught! Dilshan tries to pull his first ball for six but gets a top edge that goes miles in the air and descends into Naman Ojha's gloves behind the stumps
short of a length on the thigh, Gayle misses the glance and gets struck on the pad for a leg bye
